template:

The automatic version bump for this PR failed with the following error:

```
{error_message}
```

Notifies when automatic version bumping fails after merge.

pr: the pull request that was merged

Please verify the module names and ensure they are part of the changes in this PR. Only modules with modifications can be bumped.

pr: the PR
invalid_modules: comma-separated list of invalid modules
